Not sendable as an offer

Hello,

Thank you for your enquiry. As specified, we can't meet this request, for two reasons:

- **Group size:** You have 30 people. Our largest room, the Loft, holds a maximum of 24, and the Studio holds a maximum of 12.
- **Duration:** You asked for 6 hours. We only offer 4-hour bookings, and there is no longer-duration option or price.

Because of this, we can't put together a package that matches your request, and so we can't compare one against your budget.

There is one alternative. You would have to agree to it, and it means giving up some of what you asked for:



| Option | Package | People | Total | What the client gives up |
|---|---|---:|---:|---|
| 1 | Loft + Lunch | 24 | €852 | duration shortened from 6 hours to the only available 4-hour block; headcount reduced from 30 to at most 24 |

Every option changes a stated requirement and needs the client's explicit consent.



This option is the Loft with lunch for up to 24 people. It gives up the 6-hour length, because the booking would be a single 4-hour block. It also gives up your full group, because the headcount would drop from 30 to at most 24.

You asked us to confirm today. We can't do that from this message. Availability for any date has to be checked separately, and nothing is held for you at this point.

If the alternative could work for you, or if you'd like to talk through other ways to split or shorten the event, please get in touch.

Kind regards
